$comment: Single source of truth for log alerts. infrastructure/main.bicep deploys every entry; tests/test_alert_catalog.py enforces the design rules in docs/alert-design.md. route: page = on-call paging + ticket, ticket = ticket/email only, none = dashboard only.

logAlerts.description: An Azure Monitor Agent heartbeat was received in the last hour but not in the last 10 minutes: the VM, its agent, or its network path is down.
logAlerts.query:
Heartbeat
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer, _ResourceId
| where LastHeartbeat < ago(10m)

logAlerts.description: Minimum free space on a VM logical disk was below 10% for two consecutive evaluations. Requires VM insights performance collection.
logAlerts.query:
InsightsMetrics
| where Namespace == 'LogicalDisk' and Name == 'FreeSpacePercentage'
| extend Disk = tostring(parse_json(Tags)['vm.azm.ms/mountId'])
| summarize AggregatedValue = min(Val) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Disk

logAlerts.description: Minimum free space on a VM logical disk was below 5%. Services that write logs or data on this volume are at imminent risk.
logAlerts.query:
InsightsMetrics
| where Namespace == 'LogicalDisk' and Name == 'FreeSpacePercentage'
| extend Disk = tostring(parse_json(Tags)['vm.azm.ms/mountId'])
| summarize AggregatedValue = min(Val) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Disk

logAlerts.description: One or more backup jobs failed. One alert per backup item, so a vault-wide problem produces one alert per protected item.
logAlerts.query:
AddonAzureBackupJobs
| where JobOperation == 'Backup' and JobStatus == 'Failed'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by JobUniqueId
| project TimeGenerated, BackupItemUniqueId, JobFailureCode, VaultName = tostring(split(VaultUniqueId, '/')[-1])

logAlerts.description: A SQL database protected by Azure Backup has had no successful log backup for 60 minutes. Until log backups resume, the transaction log can't truncate and will grow until its disk is full. Added after INC-SIM-0001.
logAlerts.query:
AddonAzureBackupJobs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| where JobOperation == 'Log'
| summarize LastSuccess = maxif(TimeGenerated, JobStatus == 'Completed'), Attempts = count() by BackupItemUniqueId
| where Attempts > 0 and (isnull(LastSuccess) or LastSuccess < ago(60m))

logAlerts.description: A Kubernetes node reported a status other than Ready for 10 minutes. AKS auto-repair may already be acting.
logAlerts.query:
KubeNodeInventory
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Status) by Computer, ClusterName
| where Status != 'Ready'

logAlerts.description: A container's restart count increased by more than 3 in 30 minutes (likely CrashLoopBackOff or failing liveness probe).
logAlerts.query:
KubePodInventory
| where ContainerRestartCount > 0
| summarize Restarts = max(ContainerRestartCount) - min(ContainerRestartCount) by ClusterName, Namespace, Name, ContainerName
| where Restarts > 3

logAlerts.description: More than 20 Forbidden responses from one caller in 15 minutes: a misconfigured identity after a change, or someone probing for secrets.
logAlerts.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT' and httpStatusCode_d == 403
| summarize AggregatedValue = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), Resource, CallerIPAddress, identity_claim_appid_g
